name: Private Access
notes: JARED is back on your desktop until you set up Private Mode, then it moves into the encrypted workspace.
Sovel menu → Set Up Private Workspace opens a guided setup. Afterwards the same item, or Super+Shift+P, opens Private Mode.
Normal Mode starts on the city wallpaper. The violet landscape, spider emblem and laboratory now belong to Private Mode.
Super+Shift+P explains what is wrong instead of doing nothing, and never locks for a private sign-in that is not running.
The isolation check and private audit log open from Settings again. New command: sovel-mode doctor.
